note: Seeded at 0. odoo.cli was measured by NO type gate: mypy.ini scopes the six framework packages and odoo.tools has its own floor, so the CLI package -- every entry point odoo-bin exposes -- sat outside both. It measured 55 errors in 8 of its 16 files when first run; all 55 are fixed in the commit that opens this floor, so the floor opens at zero rather than banking debt. Its own floor, not folded into mypy or mypy_tools, for the reason py_typecheck.yml gives for keeping odoo.tools separate: one integer over several scopes makes every future move ambiguous between them.
